text: Fifty DC legends. Can you name them?
Seven seconds. Name the shadow. Let's go.
The Dark Knight of Gotham. No powers. Just will. Who is he?
BATMAN! Bruce Wayne. The world's greatest detective.
Faster than a speeding bullet. The original. The gold standard. Name him.
SUPERMAN! The Man of Steel. Clark Kent.
Amazon warrior princess. Born of legend. Forged in battle. Who is she?
WONDER WOMAN! Diana Prince. Daughter of Zeus.
The Fastest Man Alive. Connected to the Speed Force itself. Who is he?
THE FLASH! Barry Allen. If you blinked, he already lapped you.
King of Atlantis. Commander of everything beneath the waves. Name him.
AQUAMAN! Arthur Curry. Seven seas, one king.
Willpower forged into light. The ring chose him. Who is he?
GREEN LANTERN! Hal Jordan. In brightest day, in blackest night.
Ancient power. Modern fury. He was the champion before Shazam. Who is he?
BLACK ADAM! One magic word — the skies crack.
Why so serious? Gotham's most dangerous clown. Who is he?
THE JOKER! No real name. Just chaos wearing a smile.
The last son of Mars. Shape-shifter. Telepath. Who is he?
MARTIAN MANHUNTER! J'onn J'onzz. The loneliest hero in the DC universe.
Destroyer of worlds. Seeker of the Anti-Life Equation. Who is this?
DARKSEID! His Omega Beams never miss. Never.
The original Boy Wonder — all grown up. Who is he?
NIGHTWING! Dick Grayson. Even Batman respects this one.
A time traveler from the future, chasing fame and glory. Who is he?
BOOSTER GOLD! He stole his suit from a museum. Saved the timeline. Nobody knows it.
Superman's cousin — but she actually remembers Krypton. Who is she?
SUPERGIRL! Kara Zor-El. Just as powerful. Way more Kryptonian.
Nature's most dangerous botanist. One kiss — and you're hers. Who is she?
POISON IVY! Pamela Isley. Gotham's most genuinely terrifying villain.
Chain-smoking occult detective. He's cheated the devil. More than once. Who is he?
JOHN CONSTANTINE! The best in the game. The worst person to trust.
Mister J's most devoted fan. The best thing to ever escape Arkham. Who is she?
HARLEY QUINN! Doctor Harleen Quinzel. She came to study the Joker. Never really left.
The world's greatest assassin. Uses nine percent of his brain. Who is he?
DEATHSTROKE! Slade Wilson. He neutralized the entire Justice League. Alone.
Solar-powered alien princess. The longer she's in sunlight — the stronger she gets. Who is she?
STARFIRE! Koriand'r of Tamaran. No ceiling on that power.
Every animal on Earth. One body. The fun guy on a serious team. Who is he?
BEAST BOY! Garfield Logan. Yes. He can go full T-Rex.
Half man, half machine. One hundred percent hero. Who is he?
CYBORG! Victor Stone. His father built his new body overnight.
The Demon's Head. Immortal eco-terrorist. Centuries old. Who is he?
RA'S AL GHUL! The Lazarus Pit grants him eternal life. The one villain Batman genuinely fears.
An alien scarab — fused permanently to his spine. He didn't ask for this. Who is he?
BLUE BEETLE! Jaime Reyes. The scarab chose him. He chose to be a hero.
Guardian of the Green. He thought he was a man — until he learned the terrifying truth. Who is he?
SWAMP THING! He's not a man who became a plant. The other way around.
The Emerald Archer. Lost everything on a desert island. Found his purpose there. Who is he?
GREEN ARROW! Oliver Queen. Most dangerous man with a bow on the planet.
Every decision ruled by a coin flip. Gotham's fallen DA. Who is he?
TWO-FACE! Harvey Dent. One acid attack. Everything changed.
Twenty-five down. Comment your score right now. Harder rounds ahead.
The last Czarnian alive — because he killed the rest of them himself. Who is he?
LOBO! Heaven AND Hell rejected him. He just kept coming back.
A stretchy thief turned stretchy hero. Batman calls him the most dangerous man alive. Who is he?
PLASTIC MAN! Eel O'Brian. The most underestimated powerhouse in DC.
Thief with a conscience. Batman's greatest weakness — and his greatest ally. Who is she?
CATWOMAN! Selina Kyle. The woman who got Bruce Wayne to say yes.
A criminal who literally cannot stop leaving clues. His compulsion is his greatest weakness. Who is he?
THE RIDDLER! Edward Nygma. Most intellectually arrogant villain in Gotham. By far.
Helmet of Nabu. Champion of Order. The most powerful sorcerer in the DC universe. Who is he?
DOCTOR FATE! Kent Nelson. Put on the helmet — Nabu might not give you back.
Shrinks to subatomic scale. Full mass at any size. Who is he?
THE ATOM! Ray Palmer. Smallest hero. Biggest punch.
The world's most dangerous intellect. The only man Superman has ever truly feared. Who is he?
LEX LUTHOR! Billionaire. Genius. Former President of the United States. Zero superpowers.
Cryogenic grief — made into a weapon. He's not evil. He's desperate. Who is he?
MISTER FREEZE! Victor Fries. Trying to save his wife. His suit keeps him alive at minus a hundred degrees.
Gotham's sewer-dwelling predator. Born different. Treated worse. Who is he?
KILLER CROC! Waylon Jones. A skin condition gave him reptile scales. It never stops growing.
Fear is his only weapon. And it's enough. Who is he?
SCARECROW! Jonathan Crane. Even Batman isn't immune to that fear toxin.
He broke the Bat. Not with power — with brains. Who is he?
BANE! Read every book in his prison cell. Then broke Batman's back.
The monster that killed Superman. Literally. Who is this?
DOOMSDAY! An ancient Kryptonian bioweapon. Each death makes him immune to that cause. Forever.
The son of Batman. There have been a few — but only one was born for it. Who is he?
ROBIN! Damian Wayne. Raised by assassins. Completely irreplaceable.
A rhyming demon — bound to a knight. From the court of Camelot. Who is this?
ETRIGAN THE DEMON! Bound by Merlin himself in 536 AD. He speaks only in rhyme.
Me am not Superman. Everything backwards — but the heart is real. Who is this?
BIZARRO! Imperfect Superman clone. Genuinely trying to be a hero. Gets everything wrong.
Ten left. Final stretch. These are the real DC diehards.
Magic cast by speaking backwards. Top hat, fishnets, reality-bending power. Who is she?
ZATANNA! Zatara's daughter. Bruce Wayne's childhood friend.
A kryptonite heart — Superman's weakness, walking around in a robot suit. Who is he?
METALLO! John Corben. Every single heartbeat is Superman's kryptonite.
The greatest escape artist alive. He escaped Apokolips itself. Who is he?
MISTER MIRACLE! Scott Free. No one escapes Apokolips. He did.
One magic word — and a twelve-year-old kid becomes the World's Mightiest Mortal. Who is he?
SHAZAM! Billy Batson. Six gods' power. One kid's heart.
Her sonic scream shatters steel. Best hand-to-hand fighter in the DC universe. Who is she?
BLACK CANARY! Dinah Lance. Rarely uses the scream. Doesn't need to.
Collector of worlds — shrunken and bottled. Superman's most terrifying villain. Who is he?
BRAINIAC! Twelfth-level intellect. He bottled the last Kryptonian city. Keeps it as a trophy.
Ancient soul reborn. Wings of fury. A mace that never stops swinging. Who is he?
HAWKMAN! Carter Hall. Reincarnated across thousands of years. Always finds his way back.
Never misses. Not once. The world's most precise assassin. Who is he?
DEADSHOT! Floyd Lawton. When it looks like a miss — that was intentional too.
Daughter of a demon. She holds back the darkness every single day. Who is she?
RAVEN! Rachel Roth. Born to end the world. Chose to protect it instead.
The Wrath of God — made manifest. The most powerful being in the DC universe. Who is this?
THE SPECTRE! He doesn't defeat his enemies. He erases them.
Bonus round. Let's see how sharp you really are. Whose ice-cold eyes are these? Just the eyes. That's all you get.
KILLER FROST! Caitlin Snow. It was right there in those eyes.
Two guns. One very specific style. Whose weapon is this?
RED HOOD! Jason Todd. The Robin who died — and came back angrier.
Half the silhouette. Two minds in one body. Name the character.
FIRESTORM! Ronnie Raymond and Martin Stein. Nuclear-powered and permanently merged.
One of these silhouettes is NOT a real DC character. Which one is fake?
SINESTRO! Hal Jordan's greatest mentor. Turned his greatest enemy. Fear has a color too.
Too fast to focus on. Blurry by design. Who is this?
KID FLASH! Wally West. And then — he got even faster.
Fifty DC heroes. How many did you get? Drop your score in the comments right now. Subscribe for more. Catch you in the next one.
